caption: The drawing depicts three views of the same object, which is a handled metal pan with decorative perforations, likely a bed warmer or similar item. At the upper left, there is a top-down view in black and white, showing the circular lid of the pan with a scalloped edge, symmetrical decorations, and a central motif, along with a flat handle attached, pierced by two rivets. Below this, a black and white side view shows the profile of the pan and its handle, with a measurement scale in inches beneath it. Dominating the lower right portion of the composition is a rendered, colored perspective view of the object; the pan is shown as copper or brass, with a round, domed lid featuring star and decorative-shaped perforations, attached to a long, turned black handle. The handle appears wooden and is darker, contrasting with the metallic sheen of the pan. The drawing is signed "J. Staloff" at the bottom right. The overall composition is organized, with technical and artistic illustration elements combined within a single border, centered on a light-colored background.
title: Warming Pan
